notes.title: BIG UPDATE
notes.content:
GENERAL UPDATE

Hello, we've made a big update to the game based on the feedback we've received over the course of a year of the game (Shhh!).


Optimized both maps and added/improved jumpscares.


Reduced the survival time from 20 to 10 minutes, making the match faster and more objective.


Modified the game's art and interface taking inspiration from a VHS graphic.


Removed the system that adjusted the time, now your time is no longer adjusted. (The intention was to prolong the gameplay, but we saw that it was very boring).


Among other details that were added and adjusted...


ABOUT THE THIRD MAP:

Many people are asking about the third map (Barbacena Asylum). For now, we have decided to postpone it and focus on the other two maps (improvements are still coming).

Leave a review, tell us about your experience with the game... were you scared? Was there a moment that scared you the most?... Depending on the feedback and the number of reviews, I will soon release the new map.

notes.title: Emergency update details
notes.content:
The first scenario (Morgan's House) was having crash problems after we introduced the second scenario (Witch Forest). We made an immediate update after discovering this error.

Thanks to everyone who reported.

We have also updated our voice reception system, now you have greater control over the volume of your voice.

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
We've made some small updates based on our gaming community.

Firstly we updated the camera movement, now it's smoother and more fluid, it doesn't appear to be floating.

We added more sensitivity to the microphone adjustment, as some players were unable to adjust theirs perfectly (this is due to the fact that there are different types of microphones on the market, although we adjust using various brands, some still have very high sensitivity).

Thank you everyone for your support, the new scenario will arrive soon... let's see if you can face another challenge without screaming.
